add_push_device.description: Add a mobile device's push token to a customer, so Vero can send them push notifications. A customer can have several devices.
add_push_device.name: add_push_device

parameters.description: The customer's ID in Vero: the ID your app gave them, or their email if they were added with only an email.
parameters.name: customer_id

parameters.description: The push notification token your mobile app received for this device.
parameters.name: device_token

parameters.description: The device's operating system.
parameters.name: platform

customer_id.description: The customer's ID in Vero: the Customer ID given, or the email when only an email was given

status.description: Vero's status for the request, 200 when accepted

change_user_id.description: Change the ID Vero knows a customer by. If another customer already has the new ID, Vero merges the two profiles into one, which can have results you don't expect.
change_user_id.name: change_user_id

parameters.description: The ID Vero knows the customer by now.
parameters.name: customer_id

parameters.description: The ID to give the customer from now on. If another customer already has it, Vero merges the two profiles into one.
parameters.name: new_customer_id

customer_id.description: The customer's ID from now on

previous_customer_id.description: The ID the customer had before

status.description: Vero's status for the request, 200 when accepted

delete_user.description: Delete a customer with all their properties and activity. Vero can't recover a deleted customer; tracking them again starts a new, subscribed profile.
delete_user.name: delete_user

parameters.description: The customer's ID in Vero: the ID your app gave them, or their email if they were added with only an email.
parameters.name: customer_id

customer_id.description: The customer's ID in Vero: the Customer ID given, or the email when only an email was given

deleted.description: Always true once Vero accepts the request

status.description: Vero's status for the request, 200 when accepted

edit_user_tags.description: Add tags to a customer, remove tags, or both in one step.
edit_user_tags.name: edit_user_tags

parameters.description: The customer's ID in Vero: the ID your app gave them, or their email if they were added with only an email.
parameters.name: customer_id

parameters.description: Tags to give the customer. Use letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores. The tag unsubscribed unsubscribes them.
parameters.name: add_tags

parameters.description: Tags to take off the customer.
parameters.name: remove_tags

customer_id.description: The customer's ID in Vero: the Customer ID given, or the email when only an email was given

status.description: Vero's status for the request, 200 when accepted

identify_user.description: Create a customer in Vero, or update one it already has, with their email and profile properties. Vero applies the change a moment later.
identify_user.name: identify_user

parameters.description: The customer's unique ID, usually their user ID in your own app. Give this, the email, or both. With only an email, Vero uses the email as the ID.
parameters.name: customer_id

parameters.description: The customer's email address. Give this, the Customer ID, or both.
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: Profile properties to set, by name and value, such as first_name or plan. A timezone property takes hours from GMT, such as -5. Properties you leave out keep their values.
parameters.name: properties

parameters.description: Update the customer only if Vero already has them, and never create a new profile.
parameters.name: only_update_existing

parameters.description: When these values changed. Vero skips a value older than the one it already holds, so leave this empty unless you are sending past data, such as an import.
parameters.name: changed_at

customer_id.description: The customer's ID in Vero: the Customer ID given, or the email when only an email was given

email.description: The customer's email, empty when none was given

status.description: Vero's status for the request, 200 when accepted

resubscribe_user.description: Subscribe a customer who unsubscribed back to messages from Vero.
resubscribe_user.name: resubscribe_user

parameters.description: The customer's ID in Vero: the ID your app gave them, or their email if they were added with only an email.
parameters.name: customer_id

customer_id.description: The customer's ID in Vero: the Customer ID given, or the email when only an email was given

status.description: Vero's status for the request, 200 when accepted

subscribed.description: Always true once Vero accepts the request

track_event.description: Record something a customer did, such as a purchase, with its details. Vero creates the customer if it doesn't have them, and the event can start journeys and campaigns that send messages.
track_event.name: track_event

parameters.description: The customer's unique ID, usually their user ID in your own app. Give this, the email, or both. With only an email, Vero uses the email as the ID.
parameters.name: customer_id

parameters.description: The customer's email address. Give this, the Customer ID, or both.
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: The event's name, such as Purchased item. Vero treats capitals, spaces and underscores alike, so Purchased Item and purchased_item are the same event.
parameters.name: event_name

parameters.description: Details of the event, by name and value, such as product and price. Vero drops a repeat of the same event for the same customer with the same details within 5 minutes.
parameters.name: properties

parameters.description: When the event happened. Leave empty for now.
parameters.name: occurred_at

parameters.description: Where the event came from, such as Shopify. Vero stores it with the event.
parameters.name: source

customer_id.description: The customer's ID in Vero: the Customer ID given, or the email when only an email was given

email.description: The customer's email, empty when none was given

status.description: Vero's status for the request, 200 when accepted

parameters.name: customer_id

status.description: Vero's status for the request, 200 when accepted

unsubscribed.description: Always true once Vero accepts the request

description: Keep your Vero customers up to date from your workflows: create and update profiles, track events that start journeys, add push devices, tag, rename, unsubscribe, resubscribe and delete customers.
